title: Geologic map of the Greenville 1 x 2 degree quadrangle, GA, SC, and NC
citation: Nelson, A.E., Horton, J.W., and Clarke, J.W., 1989, Geologic map of the Greenville 1 x 2 degree quadrangle, GA, SC, and NC: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-89-9, map scale 1:250,000.
notes: USGS OF-89-9 (Nelson, Horton and Clarke, 1989), geologic map of the Greenville 1x2-degree quadrangle (GA, SC, NC), 1:250,000. Units from the description of map units (pages 3-12), grouped by thrust sheet as printed; the text does not state which units lie in South Carolina, so all are recorded. Names are the legend wording up to the age or formation name; 'description' holds the first legend line. Symbols with the Cambrian sign are OCR'd as 'G', '6' or '£' (or the sign is dropped) and are flagged inferred where converted; other symbols are as printed in the text layer. Map plate (page 1, OCR) not itemized; faults and shear zones are named only within unit descriptions (e.g. Lowndesville shear zone) and not recorded separately. SUBSURFACE: none.
